browserSearchPath: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Temperature and Reflectance, Surface Reflectance
collectionDescription: Provides atmospherically-corrected surface reflectances from Sentinel-3 OLCI and SLSTR sensors observations. Uncertainties are associated to the reflectance values. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of ~300 m and cover the period from June 2018 to the present.

layers.longDescription: Cloud flag from SLSTR Level 1B, stored as 16-bit bit mask (see PUM Table 8).
